name: Minivan transfers, private or shared

seo.title: Secret Travel & Tour | Transfers, Boat Tours & Activities in Koh Lanta
seo.metaDescription: Travel agency in Koh Lanta. Minivan and speedboat transfers, boat tours and island activities. Prices online for tours and activities, booking on WhatsApp.

h1: Transfers by minivan or speedboat, private & shared
lead: By minivan: hotel to hotel, airports, piers and ferries. Krabi, Phuket, Ao Nang, Khao Sok, Surat Thani, Trang and more. By speedboat: from one island to another.

facts.label: Where

facts.label: Child and baby seats

options.label: Shared minivan
options.note: Shared transfers may stop to pick up or drop off other passengers. On shared transfers the driver may not be able to wait because of the other passengers.

options.label: Private minivan
options.note: Private car and minivan transfers are also sold as VIP Taxi Lanta on /taxi/.

beforeYouBook.pickup: Tell us the pickup and the destination: your hotel, an airport, a pier, a town.
beforeYouBook.children: Child and baby seats are only provided if confirmed in writing. The current form asks for adults (12+), children (3–11) and babies (0–2).
beforeYouBook.weather: Travel times are estimates. They depend on traffic, ferries, weather and road or sea conditions. Please allow enough time for your flight, ferry or other connection.

notes: URL /transfers/ : page à créer (décision client), commune au minivan partagé et au speedboat. Le speedboat garde son URL actuelle /tours/speedboat/.

Contradiction relevée par l'audit : l'accueil dit « private & shared », /taxi/ dit « no sharing ». Réponse client Q4 : le partagé est possible. Rangé ici sous Secret Travel & Tour (décision du chef de projet), VIP Taxi Lanta reste privé.
Minivan partagé : seulement si un client le demande sur WhatsApp, rien sur le site (décision de Jérémy du 10.11.2026).
